profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin Rotary & Mission Systems
profile.geoLocationName: Mount Laurel, New Jersey, United States
profile.summary:
“I am not a visionary. I'm an engineer. I'm happy with the people who are wandering around looking at the stars... but I am looking at the ground and I want to fix the pothole before I fall in.” - Linus Torvalds

“I am not a visionary. I'm an engineer." These are words that have deeply resonated with me describing my philosophy of work, engineering, and life.

Hi! I'm Wilfredo, a software engineer that enjoys designing and building high-quality software applications to solve complex research, engineering, and real-world problems.

I have spent 10+ years building software applications to solve tough problems in the DevOps, Machine Learning, Distributed Systems, Multi-Agent Based Simulations,  Counter Unmanned Aircraft Systems (C-UAS), and Software Defined Radio (SDR) domains.

Skills: Python, Go, Java, React, Tensorflow
Interest: AI, DevOps, Machine Learning, Distributed Systems and Multi-Agent Based Simulation.
